items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: They had Chiot, Doublet, and old man Jeannot... And old man Jeannot was a bass player.

ctx.x: Do you have any more questions? I was wondering a little bit more about some of the other dances. If they ever charged admission at any of those halls, could anybody go? Or were there just a certain club would usually give a dance? Anybody, anybody could go, anybody. Anybody could go. Do you remember what kind of bands, when was the first time that you heard a band something like George has now? Was there any old band?
They didn't have no band like that. Nothing like that in their songs? Mm-mm. They had Chiot, Doublet, and old man Jeannot, but it wasn't like it is now.
